questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is true regarding Melting Point and Freezing point?
options: They both occur at the same temperature
They never happen to the same substance
questions.explanation: C:for a pure substance at the same pressure,the equilibrium melting and freezing temperatures coincide.

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be compressed?
questions.explanation: C:gases are much more readily compressed than solids/liquids under ordinary conditions. Liquids and solids have finite but small compressibility.

questions.prompt: Expansion occurs when solids are heated because
options: The particles expand when they are heated
The particles vibrate faster and take up more space
The particles are turning into a liquid
Solids contract when they are heated they do not expand
questions.explanation: B:intended particle-model explanation. Heating increases vibrational motion and average separation;individual particles do not grow in size.
